scope: Three independent initial physical norm slices with fixed positive orientation, plus declared signed-orientation and cancellation comparisons. No exhaustive nuclear or fully coupled ion claim.

slices.label: Initial radiation stress norm; positive orientation
Initial matter stress norm; positive orientation

interesting_groups.label: Signed stress orientation and initial cancellation
interesting_groups.interpretation: Multi-parameter examples, not independent norm derivatives. Exact cancellation is initial only; rounded filename amplitudes are not physical labels.

interesting_groups.label: Strong shear, opposite orientations and mixed stresses
interesting_groups.interpretation: Same norm with opposite signed shear is distinct orientation; mixed stresses are additional cases.

cases.purpose: Third nonnegative initial Pi_m value with the two other physical axes held at zero.

observables.primary_y: log10 Y, where Y=n_species/n_baryon; ionic Y uses saved absolute census, not fraction of isotope
observables.bulk_totals: sum saved charge census for H1,D,He3,He4,Li6,Li7; passive reservoir approximation; do not fabricate tiny feedback changes
observables.trace_totals: canonical log_T_n natural logarithm, column0 T and column1 n; convert /ln(10), map exact case_names
observables.T_0_T_1: UNRESOLVED charge partition: blank annotated T ion panel; never use inherited hardzeros as a prediction
observables.n_0: new conditional total neutron inventory, explicitly labelled; n has no ionic partition
observables.zero_policy: Do not floor genuine zero to a fake abundance; show zero/unresolved in annotation. Initial T/n zero is -inf and omitted from log ordinate with explicit initial-zero label.
observables.sensitivity: At common saved z/x, delta conditional fraction = case.f - baseline.f for all9 conditional channels; redshift axis only. Not a same-proper-time difference.

axes.redshift: z=20 to2, decreasing left to right
axes.elapsed_time: each case own elapsed_s/(365.25*86400*1e9), Gyr since z=20; not cosmic age

figures.ions_layout: 8 isotope groups displaying all21 census channels or explicit unresolved annotation; species colors/case colors and charge line styles consistent
figures.stress_note: Signed stress components required; norms alone erase orientation. Pi_m=abs(P_m), Pi_r=abs(P_r), Pi_total=abs(P_m+P_r). Show initial norms plus signs in case table and concise legends.

same_as_function_of_z: atomic rate model and initial abundances
fixed_physics.fixed_means: Other named initial physical parameters, not their full evolved histories. Sigma changes expansion rate despite fixed physical density history.

numerical_interpretation.control_status: Observed L16/L24 plus tighter-tolerance discrepancy; not a certified global bound or statistical error bar.
numerical_interpretation.mandatory_pi_m_label: Matter-only atomic response is unresolved relative to the saved numerical-control discrepancy.

acceptance.initial_ordering: Positive varied norms strictly ordered after the zero anchor; diagnostics are authoritative.
acceptance.case_alignment: Unique exact case-name join; each new case has its own canonical new-case nuclear output. Never positional join old82 to new case.
acceptance.grid: 257 original samples, shared x/z verified; no fabricated IVP histories
acceptance.data_integrity: Finite stored atomic histories, nonnegative census within inherited acceptance, sums per isotope; neutron/T canonical logs allow -inf only for actual zeros.
acceptance.new_case_gate: Reuse matching L16 solver settings and inherited acceptance checks; verify initial physical fixed axes, conservation/positivity, finite257samples; retain actual runtime receipt.
acceptance.manifest: Every selected case appears in totals and ions on both axes and signed context; all8nuclei/all21census channels accounted; required28figures exist and labels reviewed.
acceptance.model_separation: Every total T/n plot states conditional all-bare instantaneous thermalization, passive background; old ions are inherited atomic model. No T-ion partition or fully coupled-network claim.
acceptance.stopping_rule: One new IVP maximum, one new-case-only nuclear postprocess, finite figure render/visual inspection and fresh scientific review. Do not rerun old82.

source_policy: Existing admitted contracts, diagnostics and original dossier source map; no new rates or external empirical validation claimed.
